_about: Hand-read attribute values for competitor_map.ipynb. Every value carries the URL it was read from and, where the value rests on wording, a short verbatim quote; the notebook re-checks every quote against the cached page text (whitespace-normalised) and treats a value whose quote is not found as MISSING. Retrieval dates come from cache/manifest.json. Service breadth is NOT in this file: it is computed in code from the page text with the checklist defined in the notebook. Review figures marked via='firm site' are the firm's own display of a third-party rating (self-selected), and are labelled so.
